title: BARMM's Macacua congratulates new SC Chief Justice Zalameda

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Bangsamoro Chief Minister Abdulraof “Sammy Gambar” Macacua congratulated Supreme Court Associate Justice Rodil Zalameda on his appointment as the country’s 28th Chief Justice. In a statement issued by the Bangsamoro government on Thursday, Macacua extended his “warmest congratulations” to Zalameda on behalf of the regional government and the people of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. named Zalameda earlier Thursday to succeed Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo, who retires on Friday, Nov. 6, upon reaching the mandatory retirement age of 70.
